stemMarkdown: Find the remainder when $131 \times 949$ is divided by $11$.
solutionMarkdown: Reduce each factor first: $131 \equiv 10$ and $949 \equiv 3 \pmod{11}$. So the product is $\equiv 10 \times 3 = 30 \equiv 8 \pmod{11}$.
altSolutionMarkdown: Reducing before multiplying keeps the numbers small — the remainder is unaffected.
